entities.summary: Jeremy Juliusz Sochan is a Polish-American professional basketball player for the New York Knicks of the National Basketball Association (NBA). Born in the United States to a Polish mother and an American father, he was raised in England and played youth basketball. Sochan moved to the United States to attend La Lumiere School, a power forward in the 2021 class, he then started his professional career in Germany with OrangeAcademy of the ProB in 2020. He played college basketball for the Baylor Bears during the 2021–22 season and was selected ninth overall by the San Antonio Spurs in the 2022 NBA draft.
